content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in West Palm Beach

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most candidates hold a bachelor's degree and have accumulated sufficient hours managing projects. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria and gather documentation before applying; Granite PM Academy can guide you through this initial step.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Our instructor-led course covers the PMBOK Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios—all on a schedule that fits working professionals in finance, healthcare, government, and construction roles across South Florida.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35-hour course, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process so you can move forward confidently toward your exam date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and study strategies to reinforce your bootcamp learning. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE, then complete the computerized PMP test at an approved testing center. Our instructors remain available to answer questions during your final prep phase.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the standard 3-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, or professional activity. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to help you stay current and advance your career in West Palm Beach's project-driven industries.
